### ISNPS 2026

The 7th ISNPS Conference will be held in Thessaloniki, Greece, from 22-26 June 2026. The official conference site includes submissions, registration, local information, and the most current deadlines, including any deadline extensions.

[Conference website](https://easyconferences.eu/isnps2026/){.card-link}
:::

:::{.feature-card}
### Student Paper Awards

ISNPS 2026 introduced the inaugural ISNPS Student Paper Awards, recognizing outstanding student research in nonparametric statistics and adjacent areas.

[2026 Award announcement and winners](posts/2026-04-21-inaugural-isnps-student-paper-awards/index.html){.card-link}
:::

:::{.feature-card}

## What ISNPS supports

::: {.feature-grid}
:::{.feature-card}
### Research exchange

ISNPS conferences provide a venue for recent advances and trends in nonparametric statistics, spanning theory, methodology, and applications.
:::

:::{.feature-card}
### International collaboration

The symposium series brings together researchers across institutions, countries, and neighboring areas such as machine learning, econometrics, and applied statistics.
:::

:::{.feature-card}
### Early-career development

Student awards, poster sessions, and broad scientific programming help create a welcoming entry point for the next generation of scholars.
:::
:::

## Relationship to the Institute of Mathematical Statistics

ISNPS has been registered as an IMS group since June 2023. Within the IMS framework, the group remains largely self-organized while benefiting from the administrative and professional structure provided by IMS.
